I'll summarize changes and push an updated commit export to Finance after the scrub. Attachments: opps-to-scrub.csv (IDs + reason) and forecast-metrics-Q4.xlsx (current numbers).

A few quick notes:
- Treat "Commit" only when (a) verbal commitment + defined next steps and (b) confirmed decision maker + budget window.

Marissa/Logan — prioritise the Nimbus Health series (RDW-NIM-34) and the two other mid-market opps I flagged. Laura — can you coordinate with CS on the technical gating items for the Nimbus deal?

Thanks — this should be a 15–30m pass per rep.

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the quick triage. Two additional asks before Finance recon: 

Checklist for marking an opp as COMMIT (apply to each opp):
1) Verbal or written confirmation from an identified decision maker (name + role).
2) Agreed legal/PO cadence (expected PO date or SOW signature window).
3) Pricing and T&Cs accepted or redlines logged with Legal owner.
4) Implementation/Migration gating items identified and owner assigned.
5) Opportunity Feed updated with evidence (notes, last SM/AE touch).

If any of the five items are missing, move the opp to Best Case and include a short note on the gap. Finance will not include Best Case in the commit export.

I've attached an example export and a filtered SFDC view: https://redwood.my.salesforce.com/500?filter=Q4_commit — use that to validate your updates. Also tracking in HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12894 (Nimbus Health).
